## Import

The data are the CDC PLACES county data (GIS friendly format), 2025 release. The file is downloaded into `data/`, which is listed in `.gitignore` so it is not pushed to GitHub.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
file_path <- "data/places_county_2025.csv"

if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  download.file(
    "https://data.cdc.gov/api/views/i46a-9kgh/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD",
    file_path, mode = "wb"
  )
}

places <- read_csv(file_path)
```

## Glimpse

The full file has over 200 columns, so this shows only the variables used in the proposal.

```{r}
places |>
  select(StateAbbr, CountyName, CountyFIPS, TotalPopulation,
         CANCER_AdjPrev, CSMOKING_AdjPrev, OBESITY_AdjPrev, LPA_AdjPrev) |>
  glimpse()
```
